A Middle East operator group — Telecom, Media & Entertainment engagement delivered by a 14-person team over 11 months, Middle East scope, commercial model: build-transfer.

items: Per-site energy uninstrumented; optimization anecdotal; ESG reporting manual.
Site incidents (power, climate, security) found by outage.
Commitment strategy unused; cloud spend escalating.

blocks.x: We instrumented site-level energy and environment telemetry, built the optimization models (load-shaping, equipment scheduling, temperature policies), and delivered the ESG data spine with lineage for disclosure. Site incidents now predicted; cloud commitments rightsized with utilization tracking.

The cadence, without the ceremony: weeks 1–2 produce the signed baseline: current per cell site performance, method note, and a control owner who co-signs every later claim. the middle block runs the pilot against live network telemetry lakes data at deliberately small scope: one path, one team, one site, expanded only after its eval gate holds. The build earns trust the same way every gate does: signals cross boundaries only through typed contracts in A Middle East operator group, so a regression is a cohort, never an estate..
